project: Fedigree selected-model tuning on LASI Daman & Diu

method.outer_split: stratified 80/20, random_state=42; consistent with previous baseline split
method.tuning_cv: StratifiedKFold(n_splits=3, shuffle=True, random_state=2026) on the training split only
method.preprocessing: median imputation + scaling for age; most-frequent imputation + one-hot encoding for categorical inputs; fitted inside the pipeline

warning: Exploratory unweighted model development on a small regional survey subset. Tuning does not establish clinical validity, causality, calibrated individual risk, or generalizability. The hold-out split has been examined previously, so this should not be treated as independent external validation.

results.selection_note: Hyperparameters selected by 3-fold CV ROC-AUC on the training split. Test metrics are one exploratory hold-out evaluation and not clinical validation.
